extension.summary: Install KingBlap Kodi builds across Kodi-supported platforms.
extension.description: Shows separate public and private KingBlap build choices for Kodi 21 Omega and Kodi 22 Piers. Kodi 22 public and private builds download from the KingBlap service; private downloads and listings require the saved 16-digit access code. Kodi 21 builds use compatible local archives selected on the device. Public builds omit saved add-on profile data; private builds may restore saved service credentials. The Wizard installs packaged add-ons, verifies every packaged add-on is enabled, supports GIPTV and XStream Pro IPTV profiles with Kodi-managed IPTV Simple, asks Kodi to install device-compatible native dependencies, sets Gismeteo for Thomasville, removes duplicate legacy installers and OnePlay, and applies the compatible Xonfluence skin.
extension.disclaimer: Public builds do not include saved add-on account profile data from the backup. Private builds may include service credentials saved in add-on profile data and require a shared access code. Review the selected build before installing it.
